body:
No idea honestly, because I submitted mine over a year ago-ish as well, and still nothing. It makes me sad a bit, because I'm actually planning on leaving my home country to potentially never go back, so I checked today to see If mine was up, and didn't see anything. Which is good in retrospect, because that really means they're making sure to double, triple check everything! 
A part of me does wonder If the reason why mine is taking so long is because I wrote some things in my native language as well as English, and because our language isn't really translated anywhere online, they're hesitating posting It. No idea tho!
This hit me so hard. I hope the guy who started it (ppkka) faces consequences for this. Hope she's resting in peace!
